title: HUMUS-Net: Hybrid Unrolled Multi-Scale Network Architecture for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
grouping: Two levels. The block's top level sits in a large light-grey rounded container, with the input knee image ('Noisy image') outside on the left and the output ('Denoised image') outside on the right; a small white box inside it defines F_H, F_L, F_D. The multi-scale sub-network is a pale-green square inside the container holding a tiny U sketch; two dotted lines fan from it down to a large pale-green panel that fills the lower half and draws that sub-network in full, with its own line-type legend in the lower-left.
shapes_depth: Flat shapes, no shadows. High-resolution feature extraction is a pale-blue rectangle, low-resolution extraction a pale-yellow trapezoid narrowing to the right, reconstruction a pale-blue trapezoid widening. In the zoomed panel the transformer stages are peach rounded rectangles with orange outlines (RSTB-D down the left, RSTB-B at the bottom, RSTB-U up the right), Norm is a tiny green upright box with rotated text, and patch embedding / unembedding are grey outlined triangles. Lines carry the representation: blue for image-space features, red for tokens, dashed red for skips. Sizes are fraction math beside each arrow (h/2 . w/2 x d ... h/16 . w/16 x 8 . d).
proposed_highlight: The multi-scale transformer is the only green-tinted element in the top view and gets the whole lower half as a zoom panel in the same pale green.
lesson: Colour the connectors by representation - blue for image-space lines, red for token lines, dashed red for skips - so the switch into and out of the transformer is visible at the patch-embed triangles without labelling each arrow.
notes: Venue from the PDF (Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems 2022). This is the denoiser used inside each unrolled cascade, hence module-detail. The figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the whole raster.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: A grey rounded top panel holds the hybrid denoiser (Hi-Res Feature Extraction -> Low-Res Feature Extraction -> MUST -> Hi-Res Image Reconstruction), and dotted zoom lines open the small MUST thumbnail into a full-width green bottom panel showing its U of RSTB-D / RSTB-B / RSTB-U blocks.
insights.data: Real knee MR images sit outside the top panel as 'Noisy image' and 'Denoised image'; intermediate tensors are named F_H, F_L, F_D on the arrows and every U-level edge carries its shape (h/4 * w/4 * 2d etc.) as a math label.
insights.emphasis: The contribution MUST is the one green-tinted box in the top panel, and its green colour is reused as the background of the zoom panel so the detail is tied to it by hue as well as by the dotted lines.
insights.flow: Top panel reads left to right with a long global residual arrow over the top into a circled-plus; the bottom panel reads as a U (down the left, across RSTB-B, up the right) with dashed red horizontal skip arrows; blue lines mean image representation and red lines token representation.
insights.avoid: The figure shows only the denoiser, not the unrolled k-space cascade that makes HUMUS-Net an unrolled network, and it carries two separate legends (bottom-left of each panel) instead of one key.

arrangement.units: one grey rounded panel for the whole denoiser plus one green-framed zoom panel below it that expands the MUST sub-module; sub-blocks are pastel boxes and trapezoids
arrangement.inputs_as: real MRI image thumbnail outside the panel's left edge, output image outside the right edge
arrangement.shared: global residual skip from input to output across the top of the panel
